description: This file declares Unicode conversion functions (u8u16 and u16u8) for Windows platforms, handling conversions between UTF-8 and UTF-16 encodings. It includes platform-specific headers and wraps declarations within the c10 namespace.

methods.name: u8u16
methods.description: Converts a UTF-8 encoded std::string to a UTF-16 encoded std::wstring on Windows.

methods.name: u16u8
methods.description: Converts a UTF-16 encoded std::wstring to a UTF-8 encoded std::string on Windows.
